Hi Asha —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

What we heard
- You want a Private/VPC deployment of Redwood to keep inference inside your VPC for regulated workflows.
- Primary workloads: transaction classification + LLM-powered summaries for customer support and dispute workflows.
- Current evaluation target: production launch Q2 next year.
- Expected token profile (rough): ~2.5B tokens/month average first year, with spikes up to ~6B in promotional windows.
- Environments: you mentioned NA + EU production endpoints and at least one staging environment (confirm below).

Questions we need to finalize pricing
1) Confirm environment count (prod NA, prod EU, staging, dev/test?) — each environment is typically a separate private deployment for isolation.
2) Target budget range for the platform (monthly or annual) or target unit economics (e.g., target $/1M tokens).
3) Preferred licensing: annual platform license (recommended for Private) vs. committed token pool + overage pricing.
4) Support tier: Standard vs. Premium (SLAs, 24/7, reconciliation windows) — which do you expect to require?

Initial action items (attached)
- Attached is a light estimate (redwood-private-pricing-estimate.pdf) with two pricing archetypes we discussed: Licensed Private + committed tokens, and Pay-as-you-go private with higher unit rates.
- I also included a short environment worksheet (environment-counts.xlsx) to capture sizing and region breakdown — could you or your platform ops team fill this out?

Suggested next steps
- If you can confirm env counts + support tier this week, I’ll turn the estimate into a formal SOW for procurement.
- We can schedule a 30-min procurement/infosec sync next week to walk through the license terms and evidence (SOC2, penetration test summaries).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a refined estimate once I have the env counts.

Ben

Thanks Ben —

Quick answers inline:
- Environments: confirm NA prod, EU prod, staging, dev/test = 4 environments. We may add a DR/secondary region later but for procurement planning assume 4.
- Token volumes: the 2.5B/month avg is in the right ballpark for year 1. We expect growth to ~5B/month by year 2.
- Budget: we have a target budget range for this effort of $180k–$240k/month for inference + platform licensing (this is flexible if there are strong reserved/commit discounts).

Procurement note: our procurement team (procurement@fintechco.com) will need a formal quote, SOW, and SOC2 evidence. Can you provide a sample SOW and SOC2 report? Also please include license terms for on-prem/private deployments (term length, renewal, and any restrictions).

If you can update the estimate to show a committed annual license + committed token pool vs. on-demand pricing (with Premium support baked in), that’d be ideal. I’ll fill out the environment-counts sheet this afternoon and return.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Private/VPC pricing & next steps (post-demo)

Asha — great, thanks for the quick clarifications and the target budget range. Agree Premium support for prod is the right call.

Attached estimate overview (summary below) — I’ll publish a formal SOW draft once we have the filled environment sheet.

Summary pricing archetypes (Private/VPC) — Premium support included
Option 1 — Annual License + Committed Tokens (recommended for predictable economics)
- Annual platform license: $120k/year per environment (includes private control plane, deployment tooling, and management console).
- Committed token pool: $45 per 1M tokens (annual commitment; volume tiers available above 50B/year).
- Reserved capacity & priority routing included for committed pools.
- Example: For 2.5B tokens/month (~30B/year) + 4 environments: license = $480k/year; committed tokens = $45 * 30,000 (since pricing per 1M tokens) = $1,350,000/year; total ~ $1.83M/year (~$152.5k/month).

Option 2 — On-demand Private + Premium support (no annual license)
- One-time onboarding fee: $40k (deployment and runbook integration).
- Usage price: $80 per 1M tokens (no commitment), support included at Premium rate.
- Example: 30B/year on-demand = $80 * 30,000 = $2.4M/year (~$200k/month) + onboarding fee.

Notes on unit economics & discounts
- Volume discounts: we can scale down to $35 per 1M at >100B/year commitments and can discuss multi-year discounts.
- The committed model reduces unit economics and gives capacity guarantees; on-demand is simpler but ~60–80% higher per-token.

Other clarifications
- Licensing: Annual term (can be multi-year). License covers platform software + patching; infra costs (customer-managed) are separate if you self-host; our Dedicated offering can include infra in a bundle if desired.
- Support: Premium includes 1-hour P1 SLA, dedicated TAM, runbook co-development, and quarterly business reviews.
- Evidence: Marissa will attach SOC2 + pen-test summary and a sample SOW in the formal quote packet.

Next steps
1) Asha: send the filled environment-counts.xlsx (or confirm it via this thread).
2) Ben/Marissa: deliver formal SOW + pricing worksheet for procurement by EOD Monday.
3) If procurement prefers, we can plan a 30–45 minute pricing + legal Q&A with procurement and your counsel.

I’ll attach a redlined estimate and a sample SOW once Marissa confirms.

Thanks,
Ben
